title: Hydrological Routing Validation & Tabletop Scenario Simulation
scientific_disclaimer: SIMULATED DOWNSTREAM DISCHARGE — NOT OBSERVED DELHI WATER LEVEL. Parameter-dependent sensitivity prototype; not an empirically calibrated forecast.

stability_conditions.violation_behavior: Raises explicit ValueError with diagnostic bounds (no silent clipping)

phase_1f_codebase_default.provenance: Engineering literature: 220 km corridor / 6 km/h mean alluvial flood-wave celerity (~36.7 h); x=0.20 for natural sand-bed river.
phase_1f_codebase_default.notes: Produces strictly positive forward and backward weighting coefficients (all > 0).

phase_2c_a_narrative_heuristic.provenance: Reported in narrative text from general CWC flood bulletin heuristic for moderate wave transit times.
phase_2c_a_narrative_heuristic.notes: Boundary condition: dt == 2Kx forces C0 to exactly zero. Any x > 0.25 or K > 48h causes C0 < 0 (instability). Kept as sensitivity option.

measured_quantities: Upstream River Inflow (Hathnikund Barrage U/S daily gauge, 2018-2025)
Upstream River Release (Hathnikund Barrage D/S daily gauge, 2018-2025)
derived_quantities: Reach Thalweg Length (220.0 km, derived from Survey of India / CWC Yamuna Basin River Trace)
Reach Average Bed Slope (0.00034 m/m, derived from regional elevation gradient: 280m at HKB to 205m at Delhi)
assumed_quantities: Muskingum Storage Parameter K (36.0 h / 48.0 h)
Initial reach outflow condition (O_0 = I_0 steady-state assumption)
unavailable_quantities: Continuous downstream water levels and discharge at Delhi ORB (CWC Station 028-MDD)
Channel bathymetric cross-sections (restricted across CWC, Haryana I&WRD, Delhi I&FC)
Spatial Manning's roughness field n(x, y)
Lateral tributary inflows (Som, Pathrala flash rivers)
Intermediate barrage operational logs (Wazirabad and ITO sluice gates)

historical_data_validation_feasibility.summary: Empirical parameter calibration and independent physical routing validation are BLOCKED by absence of continuous downstream observations at Delhi Old Railway Bridge.

validation_matrix.question: Does the Muskingum algorithm adhere to analytical conservation of mass and stability constraints?
validation_matrix.required_evidence: Deterministic invariant tests (C0+C1+C2=1.0, steady-state preservation, bounds enforcement).
validation_matrix.available_evidence: 12 deterministic unit tests in ml/tests/test_routing_tabletop.py and 6 backend integration tests.
validation_matrix.next_action: Maintain automated CI invariant test suite.

validation_matrix.question: Can the prototype reproduce qualitative wave attenuation across verified historical episodes?
validation_matrix.next_action: Use historical replay strictly for exploratory sensitivity analysis; state that outputs are simulated.

validation_matrix.question: Can parameters K and x be mathematically fitted to minimize error against observed downstream discharge?
validation_matrix.required_evidence: Continuous, synchronized downstream discharge time-series at or near Delhi ORB.
validation_matrix.available_evidence: None. Only daily barrage releases at Hathnikund exist in the repository.
validation_matrix.next_action: Acquire continuous CWC Station 028-MDD stage/discharge telemetry before calibration attempts.

validation_matrix.question: Can simulated wave transit lag and crest discharge be corroborated against independent intermediate gauges?
validation_matrix.required_evidence: Intermediate gauge records along the 220 km corridor (Yamunanagar, Karnal, Panipat, Sonipat).
validation_matrix.available_evidence: None. Intermediate gauges are unmetered or data is absent from repository.
validation_matrix.next_action: Identify and ingest intermediate state irrigation gauges along the corridor.

validation_matrix.question: Can the system predict downstream flood stage (m MSL) and danger mark exceedance at Delhi?
validation_matrix.required_evidence: Continuous stage observations paired with an authoritative CWC rating curve.
validation_matrix.available_evidence: None. Stage-discharge relationship at Delhi ORB is non-stationary and unavailable.
validation_matrix.next_action: Strictly prohibit operational flood predictions and false alarm generation.

numerical_invariants_verified: Coefficient summation C0+C1+C2 == 1.0 across diverse parameter sets
Rejection of non-positive K, dt and out-of-bounds x
Rejection of negative discharge inputs (>= 0 m³/s constraint)
Rejection of single-point or empty hydrographs
Rejection of numerically unstable parameters (dt < 2Kx or dt > 2K(1-x))
Steady-state preservation under constant inflow (0% attenuation, 0 lag)
Attenuation and lag under pulse and rising hydrographs
Mass balance continuity error < 0.01% under all valid scenarios
Strict absence of downstream water level (m MSL) estimates
